_comment: SHARED cross-language fixture pinning the un-embeddable emptiness rule. Consumed NOW by src/memory/emptiness-boundary.test.ts (the TS countEmbeddings rule). A matching .py-side test (tenant/store/watchd-checks/test_emptiness_boundary.py, asserting the .py UNEMBEDDABLE_SQL rule against these same rows) is DEFERRED to card 20c2d64b — it cannot be a CI edit-time gate while memory_embedding_health.py is gitignored (/tenant/**); until it exists the .py side is guarded by the UNEMBEDDABLE_SQL single-source constant + the runtime unembeddable tripwire. embeddable=true => in the alarm's age gate + counted against coverage; embeddable=false => un-embeddable, excluded from both. A memory is embeddable iff content OR keywords is non-empty (mirrors store.ts embeddableText). Rows 1-2 (keywords=null) are MANDATORY: they catch the most likely drift, one side COALESCE-ing null keywords and the other not. Edit this file when the rule changes; the TS test must still pass (and the deferred .py test, once built).
